ruleWebsiteInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP(S) hostname or URL without credentials.
rulePriorityHelp: Lower numbers have higher priority. Keep the default unless you need an override.
ruleSaveDoesNotApply: Saving rules updates configuration without switching routes. Return to the proxy panel to enable or apply your selection.
proxyEditorIntro: Use the details from your proxy provider. Protocol, host and port are required. Saving does not connect.
proxyEditorProtocolHelp: Chrome supports HTTP/HTTPS and SOCKS4/5. Use a local HTTP/SOCKS gateway for Shadowsocks and other node protocols.
sideAddProxyIntro: Enter the protocol, host and port of an existing proxy, or choose a local client port. No account required.
sideProxyProtocolLimit: Chrome supports HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5. Shadowsocks, VMess, VLESS and Trojan require a local HTTP/SOCKS gateway. Set HTTP proxy credentials in advanced settings.
sideProxySavedAddAnother: Proxy saved. You can add another; nothing has been applied.
sideProxySavedNotApplied: Proxy saved and selected. Not yet applied to Chrome.
sideAdvancedProxyEditor: Need authentication or advanced options? Open full settings ↗
sideRulesModeHelp: Automatically route using your saved site rules. Select Apply before Chrome settings change.
sideNoProxiesHelp: Add your proxy server host and port, or use the local HTTP/SOCKS port exposed by Clash, Mihomo or sing-box.
sideRuleIntro: Choose a proxy or direct access for this site. Rules are saved before being explicitly applied.
siteRulePriorityConflict: An existing priority-0 rule takes precedence. Adjust priorities in Manage rules before saving this site rule.
r83RotationUnavailable: An isolated collection runner is not connected. No website requests, proxy rotations or visit counts are initiated.
r83RotationLoadFailed: Unable to read saved rotation settings.
r83RotationIntro: Save a proxy pool and request budget for an authorized target. Saving never starts a task.
r83RotationScopeWarning: Chrome proxy settings can affect other browser tabs. Long-running tasks require an isolated runner.
r83RotationNeedProxies: Add at least two actual HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxy endpoints first.
r83RotationMissingProxy: A saved proxy is missing. Choose an available one.
r83RotationConsent: I confirm I have access rights and will honor the site's terms, robots rules, rate limits and authentication requirements.
r83RotationSaved: Plan saved. No task has started.
r83RotationSaveFailed: Unable to remove this plan. Retry.
r83RotationInvalid: Invalid plan: check hostname, budgets, two different proxies and authorization.
r83RotationNoExecution: No safe isolated runner is available: real requests, idempotent counts, rotation, pause, stop and restoration are not implemented. No simulated successes.
r93CollectorNewTabAria: Collection proxies, opens in a new tab
r86PauseHint: Paused. Selection changes are applied only when you choose Enable.
r86NoProfile: Add or select a proxy to enable this mode.
r86Saved: Rule saved. Chrome proxy settings have not changed. Apply explicitly when ready.
proxyPasteUnsupported: Proxy address not recognized. Enter host and port separately. Credential-bearing URLs cannot be pasted; IPv6 is not supported by this configuration.
localPortExamples: Example ports only. Check the port actually used by your client.
pageLinkCopyFailed: Could not copy the link. Check clipboard access.
quickHostReplaceConfirm: A custom host is already entered. Replace it with {host}?
sideProxyPasteHint: Paste host:port or a full proxy address.
sideLocalPortHint: Use your client’s current port and keep it running.
sideAddSaveHint: Saving does not apply the proxy.
sideLocalProtocolHelp: HTTP also supports HTTPS sites. Match the protocol and port to your client. SOCKS5 does not support credentials.
subscriptionManageDescription: Manage official and third-party subscriptions together. Open a source for details; editing and reading do not apply a proxy.
subscriptionListDescription: Select a subscription to review its source, editing options and local import actions.
subscriptionDetailSafety: Only non-secret source metadata is stored. No automatic subscription download or route activation. Nodes, usage, expiry and connectivity are unverified.
subscriptionMissingDescription: The source may have been removed or the link is invalid. Return to the list without changing your current proxy.
subscriptionOtherAccessDescription: Official accounts and local clients are separate access options. A local client is not a purchased subscription.
sideRouteSystem: System settings (may use a system proxy)
sideDirectPausedHint: Direct is not enabled. Choose Enable to bypass the system proxy; Pause restores the previous proxy settings.
sideDirectPendingHint: Direct is not applied. Choose Apply selection, then refresh the website to check the exit IP.
sideDirectAppliedHint: Chrome is using Direct. Refresh open websites before checking the exit IP.
apDiscardHelp: Leaving discards this draft. Saved settings and the active route remain unchanged.
apCapabilitiesPreview: Preview: simulated diagnostics and statistics. No real network requests, browser changes or browsing-data collection.
apCapabilitiesLive: Live proxy supports rules mode only: DIRECT by default, with 1–16 rules including subdomains sharing one HTTPS/SOCKS5 endpoint with a public DNS hostname. Global proxy, local clients, authentication, PAC, downloads, probes and collection are not connected.
apProfileIntro: Manage proxies and local clients. Saving keeps your current connection; apply when ready.
apAuthHelp: Proxy authentication is not connected yet. Proxies requiring credentials cannot be saved; unauthenticated proxies can be added.
apProxyDebugUnavailable: Local project debugging has no managed proxy authority. Configuration can be saved; real enable/stop requires installation and trusted review.
apSourceChanged: The source or permission is no longer valid. Keep the draft, reopen from the original entry and read status before another action.
apProxyPermissionDenied: Proxy permission or route approval was denied. Browser proxy control was not taken automatically.
apProxyNotConnected: This entry is not connected to the managed proxy service. Saving configuration does not apply it.
apProxyUnsupported: This route is unsupported. Use a direct default and one unauthenticated public HTTPS/SOCKS5 endpoint for 1–16 domains including subdomains. No fallback route was applied.
apConfigConflict: Configuration changed during this operation. Reload and review it; no write was replayed.
apConfigQuota: Configuration exceeds the current 8 KiB storage item limit. This write was not sent.
apOutcomeUnknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Read actual state first; save, apply and stop will not be replayed automatically.
apProxyControlHeld: This tool has no confirmed proxy control it can release. Another tool’s proxy will not be stopped.
apReplaceRuleDraft: This rule has unsaved changes. Discard the draft and edit this rule?
apReplacePacDraft: This PAC has unsaved changes. Discard the draft and edit this PAC?
apDiscardProxyDraft: This proxy has unsaved changes. Discard the draft and close?
apReplaceBackupDraft: The backup input has unsaved changes. Replace it with the selected file?
apSiteManualHint: Enter a domain to add a rule
apSiteRouteHelp: Selections describe configuration, not this website’s traffic or availability.
apManualRuleSource: Current website unavailable. Enter the domain you want to configure.
apRuleAlreadyExists: A rule for this domain and scope already exists. Edit it in Manage rules.
apStatusReadFailedHelp: Browser proxy status could not be confirmed. Retry reading the status; you can still edit and save configuration without switching routes.
apRuleSaveNote: Saves the rule without changing your connection. Apply it explicitly from the proxy panel when ready.
